notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince, Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, Prince Xizor, Prepared Defenses, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, All Wrapped Up and Imperial Arrest Order; these count toward the 60. Several Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.
Prince Xizor is listed both under Starting and under Characters; both rows are kept as posted (60 total).
Posted 'Coruscant' dested the Dark Special Edition system Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition); Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber and Vibro-Ax dested their Dark pages.

Posted 'Scum and Villany' dested Scum And Villainy; 'Oo-ta Goo-ta Solo?' dested Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?; 'Sniper/Dark Strike' and 'Ghhhk/Those Rebels Won't Escape Us' dested the combo Interrupts; plain 'Sniper' is the separate Sniper card.
Secret Plans was an Effect in 2001, not a Defensive Shield; it counts in the 6 Effects.

The description says the deck won an unnamed local tournament with 26 players. The strategy's edit (take out Jabba's Through With You, Makurth and Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; add 3 Blizzard Walkers) is not applied to the list.
